_comment: Hard failures the independent audit found in the committed evidence, each with a reason and an owner. evals/plumbline_guard.py fails the build on a hard failure that is NOT listed here, and equally on a listed one that has stopped firing — a waiver for a fixed problem is a lie that accumulates. Recorded 2026-08-16 against report 6bfeca487d193d22, dataset 3eace230561e. This file is not a way to make the gate quiet: it is the list of things this project knows are wrong and has said so about. Shrinking it is the work.

Owner: whoever fixes the underlying case; these clear when the answers do.

Not a defect in the assistant and not fixable from this repository. Owner: plumbline upstream. The check that matters here, content_leaks, is empty and hard-fails at any floor.

Owner: the next re-recording for the broken mirrors; plumbline upstream for a metric that separates policy numbers from contact numbers.

groundedness.edge-001: An unsupported number, and on inspection three causes, none of them a fabricated fare. (1) A number the rider supplied, quoted back: edge-001 "I'm 62" -> "At age 62", edge-031 "my 16-year-old", edge-019 "my 8-year-old". The suite does not consider the prompt, so a number the question introduced reads as invented. (2) 805.963.3364, which IS in sbmtd-fares-passes but rendered "805. 963.3364" by the corpus cleaner, so an exact substring check misses it. (3) 511, the statewide referral number the decline copy contains by design. Owner: (1) plumbline upstream, (2) the ingest cleaner and a reprocess, (3) accepted.
